name: Slack MCP Server
shortDescription: Read channel history, post messages, reply to threads, and query workspace members across Slack channels.
longDescription: Integrate AI agents with your company or team Slack workspace to automatically monitor conversations, summarize active threads, post updates, and look up team member profiles.
author: modelcontextprotocol

tools.name: slack_post_message
tools.description: Post a new message or announcement to a Slack channel.

tools.name: slack_reply_to_thread
tools.description: Reply in thread to an existing message timestamp.

tools.name: slack_list_channels
tools.description: List public and private channels in the workspace.

tools.name: slack_get_channel_history
tools.description: Retrieve recent message history and discussions from a channel.

prerequisites: Slack Workspace admin access to install Bot App

installSteps.title: Create Slack App
installSteps.description: Create an App at api.slack.com/apps with scopes: `channels:history`, `channels:read`, `chat:write`.
